content.short: Trendx lets users tokenize physical assets and access fixed-income and equity tokens.
content.description: Trendx is an investment platform that lets users tokenize physical assets, access fixed-income and equity tokens, and borrow against their tokenized holdings in a secure and user-friendly app. For businesses, it enables asset tokenization to raise capital through fixed-income and equity tokens, opening new financing avenues. For individuals, it broadens access to asset-backed investments, helping diversify portfolios and participate in markets previously out of reach. By allowing collateralized borrowing and transparent tokenized assets, Trendx aims to boost liquidity and financial flexibility for both sides of the market.
